why: sdio-host declares MIT OR Apache-2.0 in Cargo.toml, but neither the crate nor its repository (jkristell/sdio-host, at the recorded commit 4e1a67275a928be06fc7eb537a38f32bd45b5941 or later) has ever had a licence file. The texts are SPDX's; MIT's copyright line is reconstructed from Cargo.toml's authors and the crate's publish year (2022-07-27).
